name: 課題ひな型の本文と既定プロパティを設定する作成フォーム
prompt:
Second attempt. Recreate only the supplied Linear issue-template form crop at exactly 950x610 px, with Japanese copy and source-matched geometry. Use a white background, light fine outlines, quiet placeholder gray, and restrained regular-weight UI typography. No navigation or page chrome.

Match these source-crop anchors: top document icon x=27,y=7, about 36x36; title placeholder 「テンプレート名」 begins x=77,y=12; optional description 「テンプレートの説明（任意）を追加...」 begins x=26,y=57. The large issue-body rectangle begins x=6,y=121 and is about 944x196 px. Inside it, 「課題のタイトル」 begins x=27,y=156 in roughly 28 px semibold gray; 「説明を追加...」 begins x=27,y=211 in roughly 18 px gray. Leave the body blank after those placeholders.

The section heading 「既定のプロパティ」 begins x=27,y=365 in about 18 px regular dark text; supporting line 「課題作成時に自動適用され、Linearで作成中に編集できます」 begins x=27,y=398 in about 16 px gray. The rounded property bar begins x=6,y=438 and is about 944x73 px tall. Place five inline controls in one row with compact spacing and icons: 「チーム」, 「優先度」, 「担当者」, 「プロジェクト」, 「ラベル」, then ellipsis. Do not move this section downward.

Bottom-right actions start around y=551 and are about 41 px tall. Place the outlined 「キャンセル」 button around x=777 with width about 88 px; place the filled muted blue-violet 「作成」 button at x=873 with width about 77 px, ending at the crop's right edge. Keep the buttons aligned and close together. All visible text must fit on one line. Do not add data, fields, tags, or controls. Preserve the exact vertical positions and open white space from the source.
reviewNotes: Reviewed against the 950x610 source crop. The title/description placeholders, blank issue-body area, Default properties section, five property controls and bottom actions are all present and legible. The second pass brings the body top and lower action positions close to source; residuals: body box is about 9 px taller and the Japanese labels spread the property controls farther across the bar. Raw aspect ratio differs by 0.17% and is normalized to exact crop size.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
